transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net commercial broadband support, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Marcus, my name is Lucas Vance. I run The Roasted Bean Cafe, and our commercial guest Wi-Fi network has suddenly stopped allowing new patrons to connect: their laptops and smartphones get stuck on 'Obtaining IP address' or give an 'IP Configuration Failure' warning!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Lucas. If I understand correctly, your cafe's commercial guest Wi-Fi network is refusing new connections because patron devices cannot obtain a local IP address from the router. Before we check your hub diagnostics, could you confirm your full business address and account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what is happening! It is The Roasted Bean Cafe, 12 High Street, Guildford, GU1 3HQ, customer account BB-884102, security PIN 4910.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Lucas, that confirms your commercial account details. Let us inspect your S-Net Business Hub router configuration and local DHCP lease table.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. Our point of sale system on the private network is working fine, but the guest network is totally frozen for customers.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the local network telemetry and DHCP pool allocations on your Business Hub?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Lucas. The router diagnostics indicate that your guest Wi-Fi subnet has exhausted all available IP leases in its assigned DHCP scope.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would the DHCP scope run out of IP addresses all of a sudden?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The default guest configuration allocates a /28 subnet with only fourteen usable IP addresses and a seventy-two-hour lease expiration timer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fourteen addresses?! We have fifty customers an hour passing through our cafe!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because previous patrons' devices remain registered in the lease cache for three full days, new customer devices are rejected when the table hits fourteen active leases.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we expand the guest IP scope and shorten that lease timer right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, we can expand your guest subnet to a /24 scope providing two hundred and fifty-four usable IP addresses and reduce the lease time to two hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be ideal for a fast-turnover coffee shop environment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will push the updated DHCP scope parameters directly to your Business Hub via our cloud management console.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will pushing that update disrupt our payment card machines on the private LAN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, the private LAN operates on an entirely separate VLAN subnet 192.168.1.0/24 with its own dedicated DHCP pool.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a huge relief; we cannot afford to lose card payment processing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously guest Wi-Fi networks will stop handing out IP addresses once the allocated DHCP lease scope fills up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I understand the technical cause now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Lucas speaking, my coffee shop is packed with morning customers waiting for coffee, and twenty patrons are yelling at my baristas because they cannot connect their laptops to the guest Wi-Fi! In our business, no Wi-Fi means customers walk out the door and leave one-star Google reviews! I am stressed out and losing revenue every single minute!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the intense stress and financial pressure this is causing during your morning peak rush, Lucas. Having paying customers unable to connect to Wi-Fi while ordering coffee is urgent for your business, and I will resolve this DHCP pool limit with you right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus, I really appreciate you taking this seriously.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have expanded the guest subnet to 192.168.10.0/24 with an address pool from .10 to .250, and reduced the DHCP lease duration to one hundred and twenty minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have the new settings taken effect on the hub?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The configuration payload has been successfully applied to your Business Hub. I have also cleared the stale lease cache.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me grab my iPad here on the counter and try connecting to the guest network.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please select 'Cafe Guest Wi-Fi' on your iPad and check if it successfully negotiates an IP address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Forgetting Guest Wi-Fi on my iPad... Tapping S-Net Cafe Guest Wi-Fi now...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What does the iPad network status display once connected?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A blue checkmark appeared instantly! It assigned IP address 192.168.10.15 with a full four-bar connection!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you also verify that a guest captive portal terms splash page loads properly?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opening Safari browser... The terms splash page loaded immediately! Tapped 'Accept & Connect', and our cafe website popped up!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent! Let us verify internet throughput and DNS resolution on that guest session.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Running a speed test on the guest network... It is delivering eighty-five megabits download and twenty megabits upload with fifteen milliseconds latency!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms fast, unrestricted guest connectivity with two hundred and forty available IP addresses remaining.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: One of our regular patrons sitting in the corner just gave me a thumbs up - his laptop connected automatically!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The shortened two-hour lease timer will ensure stale smartphone addresses recycle continuously throughout trading hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That completely resolves the bottleneck. All twelve customers who were complaining are online and working happily now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have saved the DHCP subnet profile as the permanent default on your Business Hub cloud profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will these settings persist if the router reboots after a power cut?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just making sure I have the exact commercial account reference on this router configuration ticket: that was BB-884102, wasn't it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, BB-884102 is our business account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the cloud management system syncs the configuration to non-volatile flash memory, so reboots will preserve the 254-device pool.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is fantastic engineering. You have saved our morning trade, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented all configuration updates under technical reference COM-99214-B.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: COM-99214-B, recorded in our store logbook.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude, would you like me to enable automated email alerts if guest pool utilization ever exceeds eighty percent?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, set alerts to manager@roastedbeancafe.co.uk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Threshold alerts enabled for manager@roastedbeancafe.co.uk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Superb service. Thank you so much for your rapid help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your commercial broadband I can assist you with today, Lucas?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Marcus, you have fixed everything perfectly. Thank you again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net commercial broadband support, Lucas. Have a successful and busy day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
